original.target_description: Regression relationship between discipline and customer delivery time in the Swiss sample. Located R2 is for the combined regression on simplicity and discipline factors, rather than a separate regression for the named predictor group.

n.sample_role: Manufacturing companies/sites in the Swiss final country sample; test-specific analytic N not printed.
n.exclusions: Food and Tobacco, Chemical and Textile sectors and sectors with fewer than 30 sites were omitted (p. 137). Test-specific missing-data exclusions are not reported.
n.location: p. 137, final-sample description and Fig. 3; p. 145, Table III

es.location: p. 145 (PDF page 13), Appendix D, Table III, R2 cell for the named outcome

p.location: p. 145 (PDF page 13), Appendix D, Table III, combined regression model

notes: Published article copy, Collins, Cordon and Julien (1998). R2 cell visually verified on rendered primary page. No separate simplicity-only or discipline-only R2 is printed. Table R2 is the full outcome regression across both predictor groups; target_match is false for a group-specific interpretation. No model-level P-value is printed: coefficient P-values belong to individual predictors and cannot be paired with the overall R2. Swiss exact country N is absent from canonical TXT; rendered Fig. 3 reports 12%, which is not converted to N.
